verdict.rationale: Together AI is API-first, and the evidence covers the main workflows programmatically. Inference across chat, image, audio and embeddings goes through one API, and there is a REST API with an official TypeScript SDK. Fine-tuning is explicitly launchable from the console, the API/SDK or the CLI, and dedicated endpoints can be deployed via the `tg` CLI. However, nothing in the pack claims full UI/API parity, and several console areas have no documented programmatic path. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-API parity statement; documented API control of GPU clusters, autoscaling configuration, and account, key or billing management; a published OpenAPI spec (probes of the standard paths returned 404); independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
